directives: First run: no historical performance data yet. Establish a consistent baseline of 8 posts this week so next week's routine can compare.
Summer is peak travel season for Israelis (July-August). Focus topics on popular summer destinations (Greece, Italy, USA, Thailand) and the savings angle vs carrier roaming packages.
Every link to the site must carry utm_source and utm_campaign (never src=esim). Target is esim.mocaintel.com with tracking params per post.
Hebrew copy: every line including hashtags must open with a Hebrew word so RTL does not scramble it.
TikTok videos: strong hook in the first second, keep all text (captions, CTA, end-card URL) in the center safe zone.
Prefer carousels on Instagram (destination guides / myth-busting) and a single bold-message image on Facebook.
